siteSettings.tagline: Taxi, airport transfers and sightseeing across Wayanad, Kerala.
siteSettings.whatsappMessage: Hi, I'd like to book a cab in Wayanad.

vehicles.tagline: Roomy, reliable, made for these roads.
vehicles.description: Our cab is chosen for hill driving: a smooth ride, a big boot for holiday luggage, and air-conditioning that keeps up on warm afternoons in the plains.

places.name: Edakkal Caves
places.description: Prehistoric rock carvings inside a natural cave high on Ambukuthi Hill.

places.name: Banasura Sagar Dam
places.description: A huge earth dam with island-dotted waters, boating and wide reservoir views.

places.name: Chembra Peak
places.description: Wayanad's highest peak and its famous heart-shaped lake on the way up.

places.name: Pookode Lake
places.description: A freshwater lake ringed by forest, with pedal boats and an easy walking path.

places.name: Soochipara Falls
places.description: A three-tiered waterfall reached by a short walk through the forest.

places.name: Kuruva Island
places.description: Bamboo-shaded river islands on the Kabini, reached by raft.

places.name: Thirunelli Temple
places.description: An ancient Vishnu temple set deep in the Brahmagiri hills.

places.name: Muthanga Wildlife Sanctuary
places.description: Jeep safaris through elephant country, bordering Bandipur and Mudumalai.

places.name: Lakkidi Viewpoint
places.description: The top of the Churam, with valley views and mist rolling over the road.

places.name: Meenmutty Falls
places.description: A tall cascade at the end of a forest trek. Best after the rains.

services.title: Airport & railway transfers
services.summary: On-time pickups and drops between Wayanad and the airports, railway stations and big cities around it. Share your flight or train details and your driver will be waiting.

services.title: Wayanad sightseeing
services.summary: Full-day or half-day tours. Tell us what you like and we'll plan a route without backtracking.

services.title: Outstation trips
services.summary: Ooty, Coorg, Mysuru, Bengaluru, Kochi and beyond. One-way or round trip.

services.title: Resort & homestay pickups
services.summary: Door-to-door, even up the narrow estate roads that confuse map apps.

services.title: Local & hourly rides
services.summary: Shopping, hospital visits, family functions. Keep the cab for as long as you need it.

travelTips.title: The Bandipur night ban
travelTips.body: NH 766 through Bandipur, towards Mysuru and Bengaluru, is closed to most traffic from 9 PM to 6 AM. We'll time your departure around it.

travelTips.title: Monsoon months
travelTips.body: June to September brings heavy rain and roaring waterfalls. Some spots and treks may close. Ask us what's open before you plan.

travelTips.title: Edakkal Caves
travelTips.body: Usually closed on Mondays, and the last stretch is a steep climb. Go early to beat the queue.

travelTips.title: Chembra trek
travelTips.body: Entry is managed by the Forest Department and is sometimes closed. Check with us a day before.

travelTips.title: Best time to visit
travelTips.body: October to May is pleasant and mostly dry. December and January mornings are cool and misty.

faqs.question: How do I book a cab?
faqs.answer: Call us or send a WhatsApp message with your pickup point, date, time and number of passengers. We'll confirm the fare and share your driver's details.

faqs.question: Do you offer airport and railway pickups?
faqs.answer: Yes. We cover Calicut and Kannur airports, Kozhikode railway station, and Mysuru and Bengaluru. Share your flight or train details and your driver will be waiting when you arrive.

faqs.question: How is the fare decided?
faqs.answer: It depends on the distance, the type of trip and any waiting time. We tell you the full fare before the trip, so there are no surprises at the end.

faqs.question: How many people fit in an Etios?
faqs.answer: Up to 4 passengers plus the driver, with a large boot for luggage. If your group is bigger, call us and we'll help you plan.

faqs.question: Can you plan a sightseeing day for us?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tell us what you enjoy (waterfalls, treks, temples, wildlife) and how much time you have. We'll suggest a route that avoids backtracking.

faqs.question: Do you drive early in the morning or late at night?
faqs.answer: Yes, early and late pickups can be arranged. For Mysuru and Bengaluru trips we plan around the Bandipur night travel ban.

features.title: Drivers from Wayanad
features.body: They know the shortcuts, the viewpoints and the best places to stop for tea.

features.title: Clean, A/C cars
features.body: Washed and checked before every trip. No smoke, no smells, no surprises.

features.title: Fare told upfront
features.body: You'll know the full fare before you get in. No haggling at the end.

features.title: On time, every time
features.body: We plan around ghat traffic so you never miss a flight or train.

features.title: Early & late pickups
features.body: Dawn flights and late-night trains are no problem.

features.title: Family friendly
features.body: Patient drivers, steady driving and stops whenever the kids need one.
